blocks.text: This page recalls Banda Singh's earlier stay in Malerkotla and the boon requested there, then follows the consequences of sparing part of the town. Surviving Pathans fled toward Delhi and Lahore, carrying the news of defeat and showing how mercy in one place could still generate fear across a wider region.

At the same time, Pathan property was confiscated, revenues were redistributed, and the remaining symbols of hostile authority were stripped of security. The page therefore balances clemency, plunder, and punitive memory rather than presenting Malerkotla as a simple sack.

Read with its neighbors, it belongs to a longer reckoning over who would be spared, who would flee, and what signs of earlier dominance would be left standing. The episode is political settlement through selective destruction.
